objective: The record's rule Q and rule R (as a treatment of a short knot), under every index registered, and a ladder of laws of ancestor-taking, run on the ring that returns and on the two-knot part that copies itself; the paired test of each start with the second part present, barred, and never made; the knot test under parity and not-all-equal. First discriminator: the gate against the two existing engines, then whether any two parts that came apart meet again under rule Q or rule R. Stop when each recorded law has a verdict and the least rung at which a part's course depends on another through a meeting is identified with its cost, or every rung has failed with its reason.
status: Computed 2026-11-25, referee pending; one registered run unfinished (stress test pending): under rule Q and rule R no parts that share nothing become one part again (an argument, borne out on every pair tested), and both rules undo the ring that returns and the part that copies itself; under laws in which a birth takes a distinction none of its parents holds, 216 confirmed cases of one part's course differing with another stopped, 62 with an ancestral common knot among the links; no case survives a change of its ration, and none depends on what the other part is. 16 of 19 predictions hold.
title: Parts that meet again: the record's laws of taking a shared distinction and a ladder of ancestor-taking, each start grown with and without the second part
